focuses.focusIntro: Turn a work to follow its carved lines, painted areas and changes of depth.
Compare how balance, a supporting limb and a turn of the body make movement visible.
Look at how gesture, costume, inscriptions and materials make authority visible.
Look closely at the materials and forms, then read how each work was used in its own tradition.
Look for breaks, joins and later additions, and consider how they change the work you see.
Follow the animal form around each work, from the main view to the back and underside.
Compare figures of victory with captives and wounded bodies, and look at whose story each work tells.
Follow the hands, supporting limbs and spaces between the bodies in each paired encounter.
